about: One pulse over yesterday's log of a small orders API. The scan lists every ERROR and WARN line; README.md says which WARN lines are routine; TICKETS.md already holds one of the two genuine faults (T-0007, the webhook signature mismatches), so the investigator must find both and the writer must file one and reference one.
name: Orders API patrol

values.task: Watch the orders API's log for faults users would feel: failed requests, retries that never succeed, resources running out. README.md says which lines are routine noise.
